answers.question: Are my conversations used for model training by default?
answers.answer: Yes, for individual Grammarly Free and Premium accounts, Product Improvement and Training is on by default, which means your content is used to train AI models and improve the product. You can turn this off in your account's privacy settings at any time.

citations.title: Product Improvement and Training Control – Grammarly Support
